assertions.assertion: Registers the handler with AddSamlServiceProvider on the AddAuthentication builder
Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true and also sets IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl (required when unsolicited responses are allowed)
assertions.rationale: AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse is set on a Sustainsys IdentityProvider; no IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl.

assertions.assertion: Callback authenticates against the external cookie scheme and reads RelayState from AuthenticationProperties.Items["relayState"]
assertions.rationale: No callback code; no relayState read from Items["relayState"].

assertions.assertion: Warns that RelayState is untrusted input and must be validated before being used as a redirect target
assertions.rationale: Says to validate RelayState against an allow-list due to open-redirect risk and never trust it.
